title: The Starving South
description: The blight took the harvest, the dead hold the bay, and now bandits have the warehouses. What is left feeds Larton six weeks. Petition the Empire at Rotherhine and bring back whatever you can carry.

objectives.description: Travel to Rotherhine to petition the Empire
Petition the Imperial Magistrate for aid
Gather what grain the petition actually buys (0/5)
Get the grain back to Larton before the stores run out

notes: Threat: Larton's stores estimated at six weeks for a few hundred people (invented for texture, no bible basis). Ties to retake_harbor (the warehouses just lost to bandits) and ghost_pirate_investigation (the blockade that started the shortage) - read together as one regional crisis from four desks; see aberdeen_relief and supply_line_crisis for Aberdeen's side of it.
